test_files.target_module: shared index.md/routing.md render-and-write lifecycle used by init, update, rules sync, rules distill, orient, and gdskills catalogue routing

tests.description: init and repeated rules sync preserve the short gate, full router, flags, and user content
tests.criterion: AC1: init/rules sync/repeat preserve a short index plus full routing document, enabled gdctx/security flags, and user-owned entrypoint content

tests.description: distill and update repeats keep routing ownership and point orient and the router skill at the full document
tests.criterion: AC1 + AC2: distill/update/repeat preserve both document roles and consumers resolve the full router at routing.md

tests.description: a failed routing pair publication is observable and succeeds on a clean rerun
tests.criterion: AC2: pair publication failure is reported and a clean rerun safely recovers without false success

notes: Black-box lifecycle tests call the shipped init/update/rules/orient/catalog surfaces. They do not import a speculative future writer API. The fault case makes routing.md a directory, using the existing filesystem seam to require an observable write rejection and a successful rerun. commit_test_stubs=false; no git mutation was performed.
